When people say “money is flowing out of the country” because of foreign vendors, that’s only half the picture.

Money doesn’t instantly leave Brunei just because a foreign vendor makes a sale.

Before a single dollar goes anywhere, foreign vendors already inject money into the local economy:
• booth rental paid to local organisers
• hotels, Airbnbs, transport
• food, fuel, daily expenses
• local suppliers, helpers, logistics

That money circulates inside Brunei first.
